patterns.title: tailwind-merge drops a leading-* that comes before a text-* size
patterns.cause: tailwind-merge treats a font-size utility as also setting the line height, so a `leading-*` placed before a `text-*` size in the same class list (or merged in from a component) is removed.
patterns.rule: Put `leading-*` after the `text-*` size in the same string or variant.

patterns.title: `rounded-full` computes to a huge pixel radius instead of 50%
patterns.cause: Tailwind v4's `rounded-full` is `calc(infinity * 1px)` (3.35544e+07px computed); fundamental-styles uses `50%`.
patterns.rule: Use `rounded-[50%]` where fundamental-styles has 50% (and `100%` where it has that).

patterns.title: `shadow-sap-*` utilities add Tailwind's transparent ring layers
patterns.cause: Tailwind's `shadow-*` utilities compose `--tw-inset-shadow`, `--tw-inset-ring-shadow`, `--tw-ring-offset-shadow` and `--tw-ring-shadow` with the shadow, so the computed `box-shadow` has extra transparent layers that fundamental-styles' has not.

patterns.title: Synthetic bold: `font-bold` on the 72-Bold font
patterns.cause: The 72-Bold face is registered with a normal weight; `font-bold` on top of it makes the browser embolden it again.
patterns.rule: Use `font-normal` with the bold font family, as fundamental-styles.

patterns.title: `rtl:rotate-180` / a right arrow mirroring an icon that already mirrors
patterns.cause: The icon component mirrors directional glyphs in RTL by itself; choosing the opposite glyph in RTL or rotating it again flips it back.
patterns.rule: Keep the LTR glyph and let the icon mirror it; no extra RTL rotation or glyph swap.

patterns.title: `compact:*` button size classes override explicit sizes
patterns.cause: Button's `compact:min-w-8`, `compact:h-*` and `compact:px-*` are variant classes, so tailwind-merge keeps them next to a caller's unprefixed `min-w-*`, `h-*`, `w-*` or `p-0`, and they win in compact density.
patterns.rule: Pass the size for both densities (also `compact:`-prefixed), or have Button drop its compact sizes when a size is given.

patterns.title: `bg-linear-to-*` blends in oklab instead of sRGB
patterns.cause: Tailwind v4's `bg-linear-to-*` interpolates `in oklab`; fundamental-styles' gradients use the default sRGB.

issues.issue: The icon box is taller than fundamental-styles' (35px instead of 32px at `md`): `tailwind-merge` drops `leading-none` because the size class (`text-[2rem]`) comes after it. Fixed in React by moving it after.

Narrow glyphs get a box as wide as the glyph instead of 1em, so e.g. the menu arrow of an icon-only menu button is 10px wide and the button 6px narrower than fundamental-styles'. Fixed in React with `w-[1em]`.

No `text-underline-offset`: the underline sits 2px higher than fundamental-styles' (0.125rem), visible on subtle links and in the high-contrast themes. Fixed in React with `underline-offset-[0.125rem]`.

The dots use `--sapContent_BusyColor` (`#0064d9` in Horizon, `#4db1ff` in Horizon Dark); fundamental-styles uses `--fdBusy_Indicator_Dot_Color`, `#0070f2` in both (the busy colour in HC). Fixed in React with the variable in `extensions.css`.
issues.notes: Decision: fundamental-styles' `--fdBusy_Indicator_Dot_Color` (#0070f2 in every theme) or the theme's `--sapContent_BusyColor` (what UI5 and the SAP theming parameters define)? React took fundamental-styles'.

issues.issue: The grid sets no typography, so column text takes the page font instead of fundamental-styles' SAP font, size and colour.
The label text inherits the label colour (`--sapContent_LabelColor`) and a 1rem line height; fundamental-styles uses `--sapTextColor` with a normal line height, so the text is lighter.
In the HC themes, hovered success, warning and information checkboxes get `--sapSelectedColor` instead of `--sapField_Hover_Background`.
The display-only box loses `leading-[normal]` to `tailwind-merge` (it comes before `text-[1rem]`); computed styles only, not visible.
Compact textareas stay one line high (26px): `textareaBase` sets `h-auto` but not `compact:h-auto`, so the compact field height wins whatever the rows.
The title uses `font-bold` on the 72-Bold header font, so the browser adds synthetic bold; fundamental-styles has `font-weight: normal`.
In a narrow panel the head shrinks to a few pixels and the title runs under the actions (seen in the React port with the same classes, not checked in Angular itself).
The resize handle has an empty `data-glyph`, so no glyph shows.
The resize handle is always at the bottom-end (top-end when above) corner, even for left/right placements and end alignments; fundamental-styles puts it in the corner away from the trigger.
The radio label text inherits `--sapField_TextColor` and `leading-4`; fundamental-styles uses `--sapTextColor` with a normal line height (#f5f6f7, not #fff, in Horizon Dark).
In the HC themes, hovered success, warning and information radios take `--sapSelectedColor` instead of `--sapField_Hover_Background` (as checkbox).
The read-only label has `cursor-default`; fundamental-styles keeps `pointer`.
issues.notes: Decision: pointer cursor on a read-only label (fundamental-styles) or `cursor-default` (Angular today: the radio cannot change)? React took the pointer.

issues.issue: Hover colours never apply: `group-hover/sw:` sits on the element that is itself `group/sw`, and the variant only matches descendants.
The on/off texts and icons lose their line height to `tailwind-merge` (a `leading-*` before a `text-*` size); computed styles only.
A semantic switch without `ariaLabelledBy` is named only "Accept" or "Decline", and `ariaLabel` goes on the `<label>` instead of the input.
`align-middle` (not in fundamental-styles) moves inline labels 0.3px down.
With `border` plus `transparent`, `tile` or `placeholder` the border disappears and the hover border is wrong (tailwind-merge keeps the later `--av-border`).
A loaded image keeps the accent background and border colour around it; fundamental-styles uses `--sapAvatar_Lite_Background` and `--sapAvatar_Lite_BorderColor`.
Value state badges use the state border tokens instead of the state text colours (e.g. `#e90b0b` instead of `#aa0808`).
`rounded-full` computes to 3.35544e+07px instead of 100%, and the badge loses its 1 line height; computed styles only.
issues.notes: The badge line height (second half) is not part of the pattern.

issues.issue: List icons and the unread dot lose `leading-none` to tailwind-merge (20px/7px high instead of 18px/6px).
issues.notes: The unread dot is part of the same row; check it separately from the icon.

issues.issue: Thumbnail icons stay 1rem instead of 2rem.
A hovered link keeps a transparent bottom border; fundamental-styles uses the list border colour.
`min-w-6` makes icon-only statuses 24px wide instead of 16px (inverted 24px instead of 22px) and centres short texts.
Large inverted statuses use 72-Semibold; fundamental-styles uses the regular 72 (6px narrower).
`hcFocus()` builds its `hc:focus:` classes at runtime, so Tailwind never generates them and focused clickable statuses lose their colour in HC.
The root line height is dropped by tailwind-merge (`leading-(--os-h)` before the font size); computed styles only.
`wrapContent` items get `py-1`, so wrapping rows are 8px taller than fundamental-styles'.
Tree item buttons get a 2px start margin; fundamental-styles' resolves to 0.
The "No data" row is 1px too low (44px instead of 45px): its text has a normal line height.
The expander lacks the button corner radius (visible only with a focus outline).
`items-center` keeps the left, middle and right areas at their content height instead of the bar's (computed heights only).
The icon box gets a 1.5rem line height from `text-base`; fundamental-styles uses `normal`.
In HC themes the focused close button of an indication-colour strip keeps the button background and border.
Links in the strip lack fundamental-styles' `fd-message-strip--link` styles (0.25rem start margin and padding, contrast or subtle colours on indication colours).
Line tiles hover with `--sapContent_Shadow2` in HC instead of the 0.125rem tile border ring of the other tiles.
The action close button and the indicator buttons lack fundamental-styles' 1px `--sapButton_Lite_BorderColor` border, so there is no ring in HC.
The KPI value uses `font-light` (300) where fundamental-styles uses `lighter`, and the active page dot uses the 0.063rem active shadow instead of 0.125rem; computed styles only.
The draggable header shows the grab cursor at rest; fundamental-styles shows it only while the window is hovered.
Header and footer render `<header>`/`<footer>`, which become page landmarks (duplicates with two dialogs) while a dialog without backdrop is open.
The title sits in a full-width bar element (592px instead of the text width); not visible.
The tokenizer input is only 16px high: `h-full` resolves against a field that has only a min-height.
The read-only tokenizer's `border-dashed` loses to the field border style, and `shadow-none` drops the field shadow fundamental-styles keeps.
Selected tokens keep their inset bottom line in the HC themes, where fundamental-styles has none.
A hovered tokenizer keeps the field shadow; fundamental-styles removes it.
Addon buttons keep a 1px transparent border, so text addon buttons are 2px wider than fundamental-styles'.
`INPUT_GROUP_BUTTON_VARS` makes the lite button backgrounds transparent in HC too (no background, no hover colour).
A disabled group leaves a projected `fdInputGroupInput` enabled.
`describedBy` keeps the generated addon's id when a projected addon replaces it, so it points at nothing.
The form header line is 3px and the group header border 1px in the HC themes; fundamental-styles uses 2px for both.
`static` messages use `w-auto`, which still fills a block container (`w-fit` needed).
In compact density the mobile shortcut keeps a 1rem end padding (fundamental-styles: 0.5rem): a mobile size setting overrides every density.
The toggle checkmark and submenu arrow are 17px tall: `text-[1rem]` drops the icon's `leading-none` (the icon issue above).
issues.notes: Same cause as icon-1: may be fixed by it.

issues.issue: The month view's short names ("Jan" in a cell named "January 2018") fail axe's `label-content-name-mismatch`; fundamental-styles shows long names.
issues.notes: Decision: long month names (fundamental-styles; fixes the axe failure) or short names with a matching visible label? React took long names.

issues.issue: The next arrow's wrapper has `ms-auto` instead of a 0.25rem start margin, so the month and year header buttons are 2px wider.
A calendar opened in the year view starts at today's year instead of the shown year.
The subtitle centres every line of a multi-line text (`text-center`); fundamental-styles start-aligns it.
issues.notes: Decision: start-align a multi-line subtitle (fundamental-styles) or keep it centred (the Fiori illustrated-message layout)? React took fundamental-styles'.

issues.issue: The selected value in HC uses `--sapList_Background` (black/white) instead of the working background fundamental-styles shows (#2e2e2e / #d9d9d9).
The collapsed value has `cursor: pointer` (fundamental-styles: default) and the column label lacks `cursor: text`.
In HC, error and warning fields show the value and buttons in bold italic (14px wider in cozy).
A focused field with a value state loses its state shadow, and its buttons keep the field text colour (no active background in HC).

Options keep the list dropdown `gap-x-4` (options with icons 32px wider), icons are 14px instead of 1.125rem, titles truncate without their minimum height, and secondary texts stop at 40% instead of 16rem.
In HC the arrow button has no lite button background or hover colour, and covers 2px of the field border (control is `overflow-visible`).
In the mobile dialog Tab is prevented in the listbox, so Save and Cancel cannot be reached with the keyboard.
A single-date picker with `dateRangeFormat` ignores the first month/year pick, then writes a DateRange into `selectedDate`.
The today footer bar has no bottom corner radius and the Today button no 4rem minimum width.
input-group: the first input of a compact group keeps no compact padding, and `hc:placeholder:not-italic` makes the placeholder upright in HC (fundamental-styles keeps italic).
issues.notes: Decision for the second half: italic placeholder in HC (fundamental-styles) or upright (Angular's `hc:placeholder:not-italic`)? React took italic. The compact padding (first half) is a plain fix.

issues.issue: `decisive` (`min-w-16`) loses to `compact:min-w-8`, so a decisive button is 32px wide in compact (`fullWidth` too, hidden by `w-full`).
Group headers in the list show a text cursor; fundamental-styles uses the default cursor.
In mobile immediate mode, Cancel, Close or Escape put the old text back without telling the form, so the field and the form value disagree.
The mobile dialog's search field has `aria-expanded="false"` while the list shows; with `noDropDownMaxWidth` the list still keeps a 40rem maximum width.
Rows are described by the list's last group header instead of the last header before them.
In RTL the collapsed arrow picks `navigation-left-arrow`, which the icon mirrors again (it points the wrong way).
The button glyph is `fob-watch`; fundamental-styles and UI5 use `time-entry-request`.
issues.notes: Decision: `time-entry-request` (fundamental-styles, UI5) or `fob-watch` (fundamental-ngx, Angular today)? React took `time-entry-request`.

issues.issue: After a press outside, the focus goes back to the input even when the press focused another element.
The popup fills a wide field while its list stops at 600px; fundamental-styles caps both at 40rem.
Multi-input options are 40px high; fundamental-styles' list items are 44px (45px selected).
The hovered multi-input field has no field hover shadow.
In high contrast the multi-input addon button makes the field 40px instead of 36px (26px compact).
The multi-input list has a background of its own (not visible).
Cozy pagination page buttons are 2px narrower because of `px-2` on page and current-page buttons.
The mobile pagination "Page:" and "of N" labels lack the form-label end margin (the nav is 16px narrower).
The pagination root `gap-4` moves the nav 8px off centre.
The pagination labels have no text cursor.
In the mobile pagination layout the nav's `aria-describedby` points at the results text, which is not rendered there.
The mobile action-sheet list keeps rounded top corners under the title bar: `[[data-sheet-bar]+&]` never matches, the list sits inside `fd-action-sheet-body`.
The action-sheet title bar is raised (`z-[2]`) over the list, so its shadow falls on the first action; in fundamental-styles the list is on top.
The action-sheet `shadow-sap-content-shadow1/2` utilities add transparent ring layers.
The action-sheet popover list has no corner radius, unlike fundamental-styles.
The overflow-layout "more" control is measured only when it first appears, so a growing label ("9 more" to "10 more") keeps a stale width.
The wizard step indicator uses `rounded-full` (a huge pixel radius) instead of fundamental-styles' 50% (not visible).
The connector of the stacked top wizard step keeps `min-w-4`, so it is 16px instead of 5px and runs past its 4rem step.
The wizard progress bar uses the `shadow-sap-content-header-shadow` utility, which adds Tailwind's transparent ring layers.
Stacked wizard steps hide their label with `display: none`, so a stacked step with only a glyph has no accessible name.

Every tab item is the first child of its overflow wrapper, so all default-mode tabs match the `:first-child` rules and lose their start padding and margin; in other modes the first tab keeps a start padding fundamental-styles does not have.
The tab tag uses `--sapContent_LabelColor`; fundamental-styles uses `--sapTextColor`.
`TabCount` in a mode loses `leading-4` to tailwind-merge (`text-sap-font-small-size` comes after it).
The round tab icon has a 16px line height instead of normal and a `rounded-full` radius (computed styles only).
issues.notes: The 16px line height (first half) is not part of the pattern.

issues.issue: The side-navigation `<nav>` sets only the font family, so its lists take the page's line height instead of `normal`.
The breadcrumb "more" link holds only icons and is 21px high instead of 24px.
The breadcrumb overflow layout's `gap-1` adds 4px between the "more" separator and the first item.
Breadcrumb items' `py-px p-0` loses the 1px vertical padding to tailwind-merge, so items are 2px shorter.
The simple shellbar user menu has `order-1`, so it lands after the product switch.
The RTL shellbar back button uses `slim-arrow-right`, which the icon mirrors, so it points left.
The shellbar search field has no `--sapField_BackgroundStyle` bottom border.
In HC the hovered shellbar search input takes the shell hover colour instead of staying transparent.
The shellbar bar and search shadows use `shadow-[…]` / `shadow-sap-field-shadow`, which add transparent ring layers.
`rounded-full` on the shellbar user menu button computes to 3.35544e+07px (computed styles only).
The shellbar `ProductMenu` never shrinks or hides, so a size-s bar with one overflows.
In an active info toolbar the label keeps the grey label colour on the teal bar.
The icons of an active info toolbar use `--sapInfobar_TextColor`; fundamental-styles keeps `--sapList_TextColor`.
The active info toolbar's focus frame is inset by 2px; fundamental-styles uses 1px.
In a button trigger the inline help's off-screen copy becomes part of the button's name.
Clicking the form label's inline help icon focuses the field and closes the help again; on touch screens it never shows.
The product-switch product focus frame is inset by 2px; fundamental-styles insets it by 3px.
The product-switch product icon keeps `line-height: normal`; fundamental-styles uses 1 (computed styles only).
In HC the split-button buttons get `hc:bg-…` instead of staying transparent on the pad (not visible).
In HC the split-button focus frame keeps rounded inner corners where the buttons are square.
In RTL the user-menu mobile back button switches to `navigation-right-arrow`, which the icon mirrors, so it points left.
In RTL the object-marker `pe-1` gap of a mirrored glyph is flipped by the `rtl:-scale-x-100` transform, so the icon touches the label.
Clickable object markers inherit `leading-none`, 1–2px shorter than fundamental-styles' link markers.
Regular and inverted object numbers lose their 1rem line height: tailwind-merge drops `leading-4` before `text-sap-font-size` / `text-sap-font-small-size`.
The card title uses `font-bold` on the 72-Bold font, so the browser adds synthetic bold; fundamental-styles uses normal weight.
The card counter inherits `line-height: normal` (14px instead of 16px), so the header is 2px shorter.
Card badges are 16px instead of 18px (`min-h-0` and a 0.875rem line height).
`shadow-(--card-shadow)` adds Tailwind's transparent ring layers (computed styles only).
In HC banner cards lose their 1px ring: `hc:[--card-shadow:none]` applies to every card.
An `isOverlay` banner card keeps the image at 50% and the text at 50% − 3rem below 1024px; fundamental-styles uses a full-width image and 80% − 3rem text.
The generic-tag status icon takes `text-base`, so its line height is 1.5rem instead of 1rem (computed only).
Pressed generic tags keep the hover background in Horizon and Dark: the `active:` classes come before the `enabled-hover:` variant in the generated CSS.
Selected text is invisible in Horizon and Dark: the text uses `--sapContent_Selected_Background`, fundamental-styles `--sapSelectedColor`.
A text that starts expanded shows no Less toggle, and a text that changes while expanded is not measured again.
The panel title uses `font-bold` on the 72-Bold header font, so the browser adds synthetic bold; fundamental-styles has weight 400.
The panel expand button's `text-base` comes after `leading-[normal]`, so tailwind-merge drops the line height (24px instead of normal; computed only).
A `transparent` panel also clears the header background; fundamental-styles keeps it (visible in Horizon Dark and HC).
The scrollbar sets no typography; fundamental-styles' `.fd-scrollbar` sets the SAP font, size, normal line height and text colour.
The status-indicator root sets the small font size and the label colour, so a neutral label is grey; fundamental-styles uses `sapTextColor` and `line-height: normal`.
The status-indicator Clickable story handles Enter twice (its own `keydown.enter` plus the component's activation).
issues.notes: A story bug, not a component bug.

issues.issue: The progress-indicator label uses `leading-normal` (1.5) instead of `normal`, so it sits 1px over the track.
The progress-indicator label spans the whole root; fundamental-styles puts it 1px inside the track border, as wide as its text.
The progress-indicator bar sits 1px over the track border, has a 10px minimum width and is 2px wider at 100%.
The progress-indicator icon box is 17px instead of 18px, with the glyph 1px higher.
Formatted-text links have no underline offset, hover colour or SAP focus outline.
The quick-view subheader's `min-h-0` drops the bar's minimum height (44px, 40px compact), which fundamental-styles keeps.
The avatar-group overflow button uses avatar 1 colours, bold small text and a fixed square size instead of fundamental-styles' button-coloured avatar sized to its count.
Avatars in individual avatar groups get no hover or press colours, and their focus frame is 0.25rem out instead of 0.3125rem.
Group-type avatar-group hover forces `--sapAvatar_6_Hover_Background` on every avatar instead of each avatar's own.
An avatar group that shrinks to fit (e.g. in a flex row) loses one avatar per measurement until only the overflow is left: every avatar width counts a gap, the last one too.
The slider HC track and progress `hc:shadow-[…]` adds Tailwind's transparent ring layers (computed styles only).
In HC the rating-indicator focus outline has round corners; fundamental-styles' is square.
The rating-indicator half icons lose Icon's `leading-none` to tailwind-merge (read from the code).
issues.notes: Same cause as icon-1: may be fixed by it.

issues.issue: The datetime-picker footer has no decisive (4rem) OK and Cancel buttons and no popover bottom corners.
The mobile portrait datetime-picker dialog keeps the 18rem calendar instead of fundamental-styles' full-width portrait layout.

The flaky datetime-picker spec on `main` is a race: the echo of an earlier `dateChange` through `[(date)]` arrives after the next keystroke, and the linked `value`/`text` signals reformat the typed text.
issues.notes: Root cause in the component (the linked value/text signals), symptom in the spec "parses typed text with customDateTimeFormat"; it also fails the root `pnpm check` about one run in two.

issues.issue: Vertical-navigation has no space between icon and text, so first-level texts are 4px closer to the icon and out of line with second-level texts.
The vertical-navigation group header is a single bold text, not fundamental-styles' list group header title.
The condensed vertical-navigation panel has a padded header, 16px header text, second-level texts 8px further in, 12px corners and a 44px header.
The vertical-navigation column sets only the font family, not fundamental-styles' size, line height and colour.
Compact dynamic-page collapse, expand and pin buttons are 32×26px instead of 24×24px: the button's `compact:` size classes override `h-6 w-6 min-w-6 p-0`.
The dynamic-page collapse, expand and pin buttons use `--sapButton_Background`; fundamental-styles uses `--sapObjectHeader_Background` (visible in Horizon Dark).
The dynamic-page gradient lines next to the header buttons use `bg-linear-to-*`, which interpolates in oklab where fundamental-styles uses sRGB (computed only).
The dynamic-page title area has `cursor-pointer` at rest; fundamental-styles sets it on hover only (computed only).
Switching the timeline `axis` keeps the old axis' inline line length and the double-layout `margin-top` on the nodes (read from the code).
The micro-process-flow root's `leading-(--sapContent_LineHeight)` gives every part a 21px line height; fundamental-styles uses normal (computed only).
The micro-process-flow icon's `rounded-full` computes to 3.35544e+07px instead of 50% (computed only).
The multi-combobox popup fills a wide field while its list stops at 600px; fundamental-styles uses the field width minus 2px, capped at 40rem.
Multi-combobox options are 40px high; fundamental-styles' are 44px (45px selected).
The hovered multi-combobox field has no field hover shadow.
In HC the multi-combobox addon button makes the field 40px instead of 36px.
Multi-combobox secondary text uses `--sapContent_LabelColor`, capped at 40%; fundamental-styles uses the neutral text colour, sharing the row (24rem / 16rem).
The multi-combobox state message box has vertical and end padding and wraps, instead of fundamental-styles' truncated 2rem line.
issues.notes: Decision: fundamental-styles' single truncated 2rem state message line, or a wrapping message (UI5 wraps value-state messages, and truncation hides text)?

issues.issue: Multi-combobox Shift ranges never apply on desktop check boxes: every check-box click clears the anchor.
Mobile multi-combobox renders the state message's id twice (page field and dialog field).
The multi-combobox polite live region is created together with its text, so screen readers often do not announce it.
The facet title has no 1rem bottom margin, so the content sits right on the title.
Facet form rows have `gap-1`, which adds 4px on top of the label's or icon's 0.5rem end margin.
Facet form rows have `items-baseline`, which makes icon rows 18px high and puts links 2px below their icon.

`data-density="compact"` on the flexible-column-layout separator buttons makes them 26×32px in both densities (`compact:min-w-8` wins over `w-6 min-w-6`); fundamental-styles has 32×24px cozy and 26×24px compact.
The flexible-column-layout separator gradient lines use `bg-linear-to-t`/`-b`, which blends in oklab; fundamental-styles uses sRGB.
Flexible-column-layout columns keep their 1px `--sapGroup_ContentBorderColor` borders in HC; fundamental-styles has none.
The fixed card layout has `align-items: flex-start`; fundamental-styles has `center` (computed only).
The fixed-card-layout drag preview's `shadow-sap-content-shadow2` adds Tailwind's transparent ring layers (computed only).
The resizable-card-layout resize corner is as tall as the card (`[&>*]:h-full` applies to it), so its glyph sits in the middle of the end edge.
In RTL the resizable-card-layout corner sits on the right (`rtl:-start-0`); fundamental-styles puts it at the bottom left.
The RTL resizable-card-layout corner icon turns with `rotate` instead of `transform` (computed only).
In RTL the resizable-card-layout pointer direction is reversed, so cards never move down while a card grows.
In RTL the feed-list desktop actions float to the start: `rtl:float-start` is added on top of `float-end`, which Tailwind v4 already makes logical.
In a borderless feed list the last item's bottom padding is 12px instead of 16px (`[&+&]:py-3` beats `last:pb-4`).
The feed-list author link renders in synthetic bold (`font-bold` on the 72-Bold link); fundamental-styles uses weight 400.
A feed-list footer Reply link keeps the link's 1rem line height (22px footer instead of 17px), and the bylines are 9.6px instead of 10px (preflight sets `small` to 80%).
The grid-list item title uses the header font (72-Bold) instead of fundamental-styles' regular 72.
The grid-list title bar text uses the toolbar label colour instead of the text colour.
Grid-list group headers that follow items lack fundamental-styles' 0.75rem top margin.
The grid-list navigation arrow points the wrong way in RTL: `rtl:rotate-180` undoes the icon's own mirroring.
After a resize or a `visibleSlidesCount` change, a fixed-count carousel keeps its old pixel offset and shows another slide than the selected one.
The carousel live region announces "Displaying item 1 of 0" when there are no slides.
Compact carousel navigation buttons keep the button's 7px side padding: `p-0` does not override `compact:px-…` (computed only).
Carousel dots and buttons use `rounded-full` instead of 50% and lack minimum heights (computed only).
issues.notes: The missing minimum heights (second half) are not part of the pattern.

issues.issue: The file-uploader `my-0` removes the cozy field margins only, so the uploader is 36px instead of 44px in cozy.
A disabled file uploader accepts the drag, then ignores the drop without `preventDefault`, so the browser opens the dropped file.
The upload-collection link title takes the list text colour and line height.
issues.notes: The React report says this was seen in the React port with the same classes, not checked in Angular itself: treated as read from the code.

issues.issue: The upload-collection title link and rename field inherit `pointer-events: none` (read from the classes).
The upload-collection button group is 4px narrower (`gap-0.5`, no first margin, no space).
The upload-collection separator has `leading-none` on the span instead of the bullet (computed only).
The upload-collection status group has no label colour (computed only).
A long upload-collection name next to a marker is not middle-shortened.
The notification group header lacks fundamental-styles' transparent bottom border (computed only).
Notifications sit directly inside a `<ul>` as non-`<li>` elements, which axe reports.
The settings profile card name uses 72 Semibold Duplex with a 1.4rem line height; fundamental-styles uses 72 Bold with a normal line height.
In RTL the settings back button uses `navigation-right-arrow`, which the icon mirrors again, so it points left.

The `compact` variant in `fundamental.css` stops at one level: a compact section inside a cozy island of a compact page stays cozy (Angular's own inheritance story shows it under the compact toolbar).
issues.notes: Shared styles (`registry/styles/fundamental.css`): every component is affected.
